name: 64424 · Bethany, MO
findings: ZIP 64424 (Bethany) has 31 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (57% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 64424 (Bethany) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
30% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 64424 (Bethany) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.
